page.title: Microsite & Sharing
page.description: Discover how to instantly expand your market reach using our built - in sharing tools and your own fully customisable branded mini-website. Learn how to showcase the entire MLS inventory under your agency's personalised URL to capture direct leads seamlessly.
page.body:
MicroSite & Sharing: Expanding Your Market Reach


In today's fast - moving digital landscape, getting your properties in front of the right audience quickly is essential. The PropertyList infrastructure empowers you to instantly share your active mandates with a vast network of real estate professionals and direct buyers.
Whether you are distributing listings directly to your clients or collaborating with co - broking agents, our built - in sharing tools ensure maximum market exposure and frictionless lead capture.

The Branded MicroSite Advantage

No website? No problem! The platform equips every verified agency with a powerful MicroSite infrastructure.

Far beyond a simple link, your MicroSite is a fully customisable mini-website featuring a personalised URL specific to your agency's name. It offers an effortless one - click setup that instantly imports the entire PropertyList MLS database directly onto your site.

Because the MicroSite is completely branded with your agency's logo and contact information, your clients can search thousands of active listings while remaining securely within your digital ecosystem. Crucially, every MicroSite features a built - in lead capture form, ensuring that any generated buyer interest flows immediately and exclusively into your Smart CRM.

Master Your Distribution Strategy

Because digital distribution is a critical component of your agency's sales pipeline, we have separated our advanced sharing functionalities into detailed, step - by - step operational guides.
To fully leverage your branded mini-website and master your external marketing workflows, please proceed to our dedicated documentation pages:

MicroSite - Share properties: A comprehensive guide on setting up your personalised agency website, managing the MLS property import, and capturing direct buyer leads.

Sharing listings on social media: Discover the exact workflows for seamlessly deploying your active inventory across your social media channels to amplify your market presence.
page.seo_description: Explore the PropertyList sharing infrastructure. Launch a customisable branded mini-website with instant MLS property imports to capture direct leads.
